title: picocalc_emu drives the pinned backend; portable verification stays backend-free

work.detail: Resolves the backend from --backend-dir, PICOEM_PICOCALC_DIR, or a sibling checkout, then runs its release binary. No backend source is copied into this repository; the connection is the pinned commit's CLI.
safeguards: The firmware's SHA-256 must match the pinned target before anything runs, so a stale or wrong image cannot be reported as a pass.
A missing backend or an unbuilt runner exits 2, which is 'cannot judge' rather than 'failed'.
A backend commit other than the pinned one prints a warning and continues, so an intentional bisect is possible but never silent.
The runner is executed with the backend as its working directory, because it resolves its default bootrom path relative to its own root.
work.naming: Matches REQUIREMENTS.md section 5's command vocabulary (picocalc test --mode firmware) rather than inventing a new verb.

work.detail: Thirteen supported and six unsupported entries, each with the gate that introduced it and its known limitations. Held in this repository so a clone with no backend can still answer what the emulator does and does not model.

Every firmware-validation/records/*/report.json is checked for schema version, gate number, record_id matching its directory, and a named backend commit. Where the backend commit sits varies between the early records; those are evidence and are not rewritten, so only the top-level form is shape-checked.

release:no-conformance-target confirms no official-sample source or firmware image has crept into the conformance-track directories; release:portable-without-backend confirms the capability snapshot the portable checks read from exists.
work.note: Publication itself is explicitly not a condition of this gate. See the decision below.

publication_decision.licensing: Confirmed clear (MIT OR Apache-2.0 with NOTICE preserved).
publication_decision.timing: Undecided. Publication waits until the work reaches sufficient maturity.
publication_decision.reasoning: FIRMWARE_BACKEND.md's public-release condition applies at the moment picocalc_emu is published, not at Gate 6. Both repositories are private today, so nothing is in conflict; the conflict would be publishing picocalc_emu alone while the backend stays private. The plan and the checklist now separate these two things, so gate progress does not wait on a business decision.

reproduce_gate5_from_picocalc_emu.evidence: test --mode firmware ran the pinned target on backend ba66390 and produced a report with a framebuffer hash, a stop reason and a cycle count. The full-length invocation is the same command with the Gate 5 cycle budget.

portable_verification_without_backend.evidence: verify reports 37 checks passing, including the two release checks and the capability snapshot, without reading the backend checkout.

no_backend_source_copied.evidence: release:no-conformance-target passes; the only connection to the backend is its pinned commit and its CLI.

verification.cli_smoke: 200,000,000-cycle run through picocalc.py test --mode firmware completed and wrote a report

known_limitations: The artefact interface is the runner's JSON report as-is. A richer scenario/artefact layer belongs to Milestone 3, and inventing one here would be preempting that schema.
test --mode firmware always attaches the PicoCalc board and PSRAM; there is no flag yet for running a bare-RP2040 target through this entry point.
Only the firmware mode exists. Host mode is Milestone 2.
